tools.description: Details for a club, identified by its URL id (the slug in chess.com/club/<url-id>).

urlId.description: Club URL slug — the part after chess.com/club/, e.g. "team-canada". Lowercase and hyphenated, not the club's display name.

tools.name: chess_get_club

tools.description: Clubs a given username belongs to.

username.description: Chess.com username (the handle in chess.com/member/<username>), case-insensitive. Not the display name.

tools.name: chess_get_clubs

tools.description: Daily (correspondence) games a player currently has in progress.

onlyMyTurn.description: When true, return only the games where it is this player's turn to move. Defaults to false (all in-progress games).

username.description: Chess.com username (the handle in chess.com/member/<username>), case-insensitive. Not the display name.

tools.name: chess_get_current_games

tools.description: List of monthly archive URLs available for a player, going back to when they started playing.

username.description: Chess.com username (the handle in chess.com/member/<username>), case-insensitive. Not the display name.

tools.name: chess_get_game_archives

tools.description: All games (rated + casual, all formats) a player completed in a specific year/month: players, ratings, results, time control and a link to each. Move records (PGN) are omitted unless includePgn is true.

includePgn.description: Return each game in full, including its PGN. A busy month is megabytes of it, so only set this when the moves themselves are needed. Defaults to false.

month.description: Month as a number from 1 to 12 (1 = January). Send a plain integer, not a zero-padded string.

timeClass.description: Only return games of this time class. Omit for all.

username.description: Chess.com username (the handle in chess.com/member/<username>), case-insensitive. Not the display name.

tools.name: chess_get_games_by_month

tools.description: Top players across daily/live formats and tactics/puzzle-rush leaderboards.
tools.name: chess_get_leaderboards

tools.description: Public profile info (name, title, country, followers, join date) for a Chess.com username.

username.description: Chess.com username (the handle in chess.com/member/<username>), case-insensitive. Not the display name.

tools.name: chess_get_profile

tools.description: Rating and win/loss/draw stats per game format (bullet, blitz, rapid, daily, puzzles) for a username.

username.description: Chess.com username (the handle in chess.com/member/<username>), case-insensitive. Not the display name.

tools.name: chess_get_stats

tools.description: Usernames of all players holding a given title (e.g. GM, IM, FM, WGM, NM).

title.description: Title code, uppercase. W-prefixed codes are the women's titles (WGM = Woman Grandmaster).

tools.name: chess_get_titled_players
